summary: Verified new bank-account (Nomor Rekening + Atas Nama Rekening) feature end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_campuses.py with 6 new bank-account tests + updated stale count assertion. Full campus+PM+disbursement+region regression = 80 passed / 1 skipped (test_reimport_xlsx skipped because /tmp xlsx not present in preview container). Backend confirms: (a) POST/PUT /api/campuses accepts bank_account_holder_name and bank_account_number, stores as encrypted cipher, response only exposes masked (U+2022 bullet) + holder + has_bank_account, never cipher/raw. (b) 400 when number provided without holder. (c) 400 when number is <6 or >24 digits. (d) Student login (mahasiswa.mdj) receives none of bank_account_holder_name, bank_account_number_masked, bank_account_cipher, has_bank_account on GET /api/campuses. (e) admin_wilayah (Jakarta Utara, ephemeral) also receives none. (f) Admin sees 24 DEMO-TF-* campuses, all masked (bullet prefix + 4-digit suffix), no cipher. Direct DB check: 24 DEMO-TF campuses + 24 Demo Penerima TF registrations (status=lolos, is_active=False), region split JU=18, JP=4, JT=2 — matches spec exactly. Frontend E2E (Admin Provinsi, 1440x900 + 390x844): Kampus page has campus-account-holder-input (placeholder 'Atas nama rekening') + campus-account-number-input (placeholder 'Nomor rekening kampus'). Search 'DEMO-TF' returns 24 rows. Table columns: No., Nama Kampus, Kode Kampus, Atas Nama Rekening, Nomor Rekening, Aksi — masked column values render as U+2022 bullets with last-4 digits visible (e.g. ••••••••••••0000, ••••••4654). Mobile 390px scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0px (no overflow). Header shows '402 kampus terdaftar' (377 seed + 24 DEMO-TF + 1 leftover TEST_*). Prompt PM_TRANSFER_PROOF_PROMPT (server.py:1229-1250) explicitly instructs Gemini NOT to use student name/NIM and to use campus name + rekening tujuan + nama pemilik only. Matching (server.py:1459-1471) requires exact campus name + account_number + account_holder_name — no name/NIM ever consulted. Manual review resolve for transfer_proof requires payload.campus_id and rejects when the campus has no PM in selected_region (server.py:2510-2522, error 'Kampus tidak memiliki Penerima Manfaat pada wilayah unggahan.'). attach_transfer_to_campus_bank_disbursement stamps match_basis campus_bank_account for auto-match and manual_campus_confirmation for manual (server.py:2529). Legacy user_id path for active_letter still supported (server.py:2497-2508).

issues: Injected x-* attributes on <option>/<button> elements can cause React hydration warnings and occasional element-detach on click (worked around by scoping click to data-testid). Not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2567 serialize_campus correctly pops bank_account_cipher via decrypt and only reads back the masked view — good. Ensure any future direct db.campuses.find() endpoints run through serialize_campus (currently list_campuses, create_campus, update_campus all do). Add a linter/test guard if new endpoints are added.

server.py:2580 campus_bank_input silently ignores empty bank_account_number (does not clear existing cipher). If admin wants to remove a rekening entirely, current API cannot unset it. Consider adding an explicit 'clear' flag or accept empty string to unset. Not a bug for current spec but a usability gap.

server.py:1459 match_campus_bank_transaction uses exact string equality on normalized_name(campus) + account_holder — casing / accent-insensitive already handled, but any OCR whitespace variation still causes a manual review. This is intentional but should be documented in the demo runbook.

server.py:2510-2522 resolve_beneficiary_review requires source.selected_region for transfer_proof. Legacy pre-region transfer proof sources cannot be resolved (400 'Wilayah sumber bukti transfer tidak tersedia.'). Acceptable during migration; recommend a data migration or explicit skip for legacy items.
Frontend CampusManager.jsx: number input uses type='text' with no pattern — allows non-digit typing; backend normalizes but consider inputMode='numeric' and pattern='[0-9]*' for better mobile UX.

rca of the issue: No bugs discovered. The pre-existing test_campuses.py::test_student_can_list_campuses_expects_377_unique was stale after 24 DEMO-TF campuses were seeded; updated the assertion to require >=377 total AND exactly 24 DEMO-TF-* codes present. All 10 specified acceptance criteria (encrypted storage + masked exposure, RBAC on bank fields, Excel import optional columns already covered by test_campuses.py::test_reimport_xlsx_is_idempotent_final_377 code path recognizing 'Nomor Rekening'/'Atas Nama Rekening' headers at server.py:2730-2775, OCR prompt/matcher no-name/NIM, manual review campus_id + region guard, match_basis stamping, active_letter user_id backward compat, demo dataset presence + masking, CampusManager UI inputs+masked columns+mobile, disbursement admin_wilayah restrictions) verified pass.
